summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Alexandre Arnault from its Board of Directors effective August 6, 2026, citing professional commitments. The registrant announced it will seek to appoint an independent director to fill the vacancy at its next available board meeting. Chairman Michael Chu expressed gratitude and noted Financiere Agache remains a close strategic investor. This is a routine board-level resignation, not a forced departure or special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or capital event is involved, so the filing does not qualify as a special-situation category.
